evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Reef-monitoring satellites could also be used to report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), explicit users (marine/conservation scientists), strong need justification with statistics and four cited literature sources. Slightly light on specific mission objectives/requirements, so not top of range.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page.
Week 10 is reserved for review, amendments, final simulations, and reflection.

criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt chart with week-by-week tasks tied to mission stages (launch, orbit, ground control, comms, end-of-life) and planned sources. However, no explicit contingency/variations provision, keeping it at the lower end of Accomplished.

evidence.quote: I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity

criteria.reasoning: Evidence of progress is limited to background research and STK tutorials; no preliminary technical results (orbit, coverage, link budget) or interpretation are presented, so mid-Adequate.

evidence.quote: Oceans have become 30 percent more acidic since the industrial revolution leading to the bleaching of coral reefs.¹

criteria.reasoning: Clear structure, well-written, consistent formatting, labelled Gantt chart with legend. In-text citations are bare URLs rather than a formal reference list, and 'Useful Links' are not cited in text — minor deductions.

technical_issues.issue: Claims near-real-time relay without discussing orbit/coverage implications (e.g. LEO revisit vs GEO trade-off); no quantitative mission requirements yet.
Gantt chart shows STK Simulations running from Week 4 despite STK Design starting Week 7 — sequencing inconsistency.

overall: Strong concept and rationale for an Australian reef-monitoring satellite with good referencing and a detailed, mission-linked Gantt plan. Preliminary technical progress is modest (tutorials only, no results), and referencing style is informal. Solid Part 1 submission.
